newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Ceara state eyes Eurobond market - paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Ceara state eyes Eurobond market - paper.

text.p: The Brazilian state of Ceara plans to launch a $100 million Eurobond this year to finance infrastructure projects, Gazeta Mercantil reported on Tuesday.
The paper, citing an interview with state Governor Tasso Jereissati, said Merrill Lynch and Credit Agricole Indosuez would lead manage the deal.
Standard & Poor's Corp on Monday assigned the state a BB-minus credit rating, the same rating as the Republic of Brazil.

Jereissati told the paper that his state's rating would have been higher but S&P's policy is not to permit corporate or government entities to have higher ratings than the sovereign, a concept known as the "sovereign ceiling."
He said the state had also requested a credit rating from Moody's Investor Service Inc and was waiting for a response.
